Four captured low bytes of state-handler addresses, paired with high bytes at $A2FC. The pairs target $A300, $A324, $A33D, $A35B. The state index has no local bounds check.
Four captured high bytes paired with the low bytes at $A2F8. The pairs target $A300, $A324, $A33D, $A35B; their state-handler behavior and ordinary-play reachability remain open.

State 0 calls the event helper at $A395; the following describes the path if it returns here. Increment $1AC2,X with eight-bit wrap. If the result is 10, call $3020, mask A with 3, add $17 with carry clear, store the result at $1AD3,X, store one more at $1AE4,X and select state 1. Otherwise return. Arithmetic is binary when decimal mode is clear.
State 1 calls the event helper at $A395; if it returns, a negative $1AD3,X selects state 2. Otherwise pass min($1AD3,X, 8) to $4342, decrement $1AD3,X and return.

State 2 calls the event helper at $A395; if it returns, increment $1AD3,X with eight-bit wrap. If it equals $1AE4,X, clear $1AC2,X and select state 0. Otherwise pass min($1AD3,X, 8) to $4368 by tail-call. Ordinary-play reachability remains open.

State 3 reads $1AC2,X. A positive value is passed to $4342 and decremented. Zero is replaced by $80; a negative value has bit 7 masked off and is passed to $4368. If the stored value is below $85, increment it; otherwise call $4B0E with A=$20 and jump to $5DB9 with A=3. On the continuing path, load A=3 and use the sign of $A3C4 to jump to $43F0 when negative or $43A2 otherwise. Natural reachability and external callbacks remain open.

Call $792C and $732A. On set carry from $732A, call $72FC and rotate its carry into $A3C4; with carry clear, store 2 plus $19E5,X at $19C3,X, set $1AC2,X=5 and state 3, then pull two stack bytes and return past the calling handler. On clear carry from $732A, call $7227 and return normally if it clears carry, or tail-call $5D7A with A=8 if it sets carry. Arithmetic is binary when decimal mode is clear.
Pull the return address of the JSR that entered this helper off the stack, then RTS to the next return address, skipping the rest of the calling handler.
Working byte rotated right through carry from $72FC by the event helper; state 3 tests its sign to choose a callback.
